meta.title: Contact Jacek Janczura — leadership roles and project briefs
meta.description: Two ways to get in touch: hiring for a CTO, Head of AI or senior technology leadership role, or scoping a project. Book a 30-minute call, or send the details straight from this page.

hero.title: Pick the path that fits, then tell me what you need.
hero.sub: Two conversations happen here. One is about a leadership role; the other is about a system that has to be built, fixed or reviewed. Choose a path and the form asks the right questions — or book a call and we start there.

hiring.title: Hiring for a leadership role
hiring.lede: I'm open to CTO, Head of AI and senior technology leadership roles — remote-first, on-site when it matters.
points: Roles I'm looking at: CTO, Head of AI, and senior technology leadership where the technology, the team and the outcome sit with the same person.

What comes with me: a company, a platform and an engineering team built from zero, enterprise AI running in production for regulated clients, and customer-facing technical leadership from discovery through to handover.

project.title: A project or an engagement
project.lede: Finite, outcome-defined engagements that end in a handover. Remote-first, on-site when it matters. NDA on request.
points: Architecture and risk review — an independent read of the system, the risks and what to do first.
Interim CTO or AI lead — technology leadership while you hire, or while the stack is being turned around.
Production AI thin slice — the smallest end-to-end system that proves the value on real data, real integrations and real governance.
AI transformation and engineering enablement — teams introduced to AI-accelerated software engineering, with best practices, internal tooling and a secure environment to work in.
